profile.headline: Eng @ OpenArt | Ex-Moveworks | Co-founder, Vizzy Labs | Ex-Quant Research
profile.summary:
Democratizing AI art creation for everyone @ OpenArt. I build the AI video stack behind Director, Smart Shot, Music Video, Lyric Video, Viral Presets, VFX and Visualizer.

Before that: work agents at Moveworks (QuickGPT, evals, CodeAct — acquired by ServiceNow), co-founded Vizzy Labs ($2M pre-seed), and quant research in Shenzhen.

Interested in agent harnesses, evals, RL for planning and tool use, and self-improving agents. Off the clock: backtesting, hackathons, papers, competitive programming and Counter-Strike (FACEIT 8).

Reel, projects and papers → alfredcodes.icu

positions.title: President
positions.description:
◦ Organized Cardinal Trading Competition - a semester long strategy design and deploy competition broken down into group of four.
◦ Co-led weekly meetings on Sundays to provide insights in trading and arranged guest lectures.
◦ Prepared weekly Bloomberg Terminal sessions at Finance and Analytics Lab (FAL) on Mondays
◦ Paper traded the congress tracking strategy, awaiting results.
◦ Spearheaded the daily logistics of the club.

positions.title: Lead of Market Research and Trading
positions.description:
◦ Collected news data for SP500 stocks for the past 5 years from mainstream news provider.
◦ Used Google NLP API and EODHD Sentiment API to analyze sentiments per ticker per day.
◦ Backtested strategies using sentiment as factors and generated a 30% return annually.
◦ Held weekly quant interview prep workshops to empower club members for future career development.
◦ Paper traded the strategy since October 2024, reaching 25% in 3 months.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.insights: Skills: Jenkins · MongoDB · Apollo GraphQL · JavaScript · React.js · Node.js · GraphQL · TypeScript · Spinnaker · Express.js

positions.title: Quantitative Research Intern
positions.description:
◦ Back-testing System: Developed a back-testing system with Python for T+1 strategies on secondary stock market, accelerating the runtime by 20x compared to former version integrating parallel computing.
◦ Level-10 and TICK Data Processing: Cleaned, integrated and analyzed terabytes of trading data in Level-10 and TICK, performing feature engineering, creating new features based on spread, bid-ask relationships and more.
◦ High-frequency Factors Digging: Based on new features created, identified 15+ useful high-frequency factors with Information Coefficient (IC) greater than 0.05 in forecasting stocks’ future return.
◦ Result: Received a 30% return in 3 months based on self-developed strategy with Sharpe ratio of 2.
positions.insights: Skills: Backtesting · Data Science · Quantitative Research · Python · Quantitative Development

positions.title: Quantitative Research Intern
positions.description:
◦ Macro Analysis: Conducted analysis using multi-variable regression in Python and obtained results in optimal explanatory leading variables across 29 industry indices, providing signal index for Macro Analysis.
◦ Industrial Rotation: Performed causal analysis on each industry index with optimal explanatory leading variables, excluding accidental results, providing help in back-testing market timing strategies about industries rotation.

honors.description: Pair Trading: Designed a Pair Trading algorithm on ETF and Future by placing limit orders and market orders to profit from providing liquidity and following trend. Ranked top 15% out of 2800 teams.

honors.title: LUHK Challenge of Fintech
honors.description:
Champion Team
We created a Neural Network with Markowitz Efficient Frontier Model to assess credit risks.

projects.title: ToolsGuru — ElevenLabs × a16z Hackathon
projects.description: Built at the ElevenLabs × a16z hackathon in San Francisco (Feb 2025): an agent that generates APIs on the fly. Ask for something it can't do yet and it writes a new tool, deploys it, and uses it on your next message.

projects.title: TokGen — TikTok trend & script generator
projects.description: Hackathon build on video understanding before the VLM era: scrapes viral TikToks in a niche, transcribes them with Whisper, reads the visuals with Gemini, and uses LlamaIndex fusion retrieval to draft trend-driven scripts, captions and storylines for creators.

publications.title: AOI: Turning Failed Trajectories into Training Signals for Autonomous Cloud Diagnosis
Echo: Decoupling Inference and Training for Large-Scale RL Alignment on Heterogeneous Swarms
